name: HOLLY　SHIT
source:
By chance, Rikuto Sekiya meets a women with the power to send people into the past. However, it seems there are limitations: she can only send them back for a period of 20 minutes.
While wondering "Can the past really be changed in only 20 minutes?" Rikuto is sent into a Time Slip by the woman.

Rikuto wishes to return to the time he spent with two girls from his past. A tragic incident occurred then. He has traveled to the past with the hopes of averting this tragedy.

However, the true character of a man determined to change the past is...?

The two girls from his past, and the mysterious woman who sent him there... Rikuto will trifle with the very fabric of their beings.

From [url=http://chibicon.net/slink/j031901/]Chibicon.net[/url]
translation:
关屋陆人偶然遇见一名拥有将人送回过去之能力的女子。然而，这种能力似乎有所限制：她只能让人在过去停留二十分钟。
正思考着“短短二十分钟，真的能改变过去吗？”，陆人便被女子送入了一场时间穿越。

陆人希望回到曾经与两位女孩相处的那段时光。那时发生了一起悲剧，他带着阻止悲剧的希望回到了过去。

然而，这个决心改变过去的男人，其真实面目究竟是…？

过去的两位女孩，以及将他送回过去的神秘女子…陆人将从根本上玩弄她们的存在。

［摘自[url=http://chibicon.net/slink/j031901/]Chibicon.net[/url]］
